exam.title: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical data-analysis experience plus hands-on Power BI Desktop and service skills across Power Query, dimensional modeling, DAX, report design, workspaces, apps, gateways, refresh, permissions, row-level security, accessibility, performance, and current Fabric/Copilot integration.

review.notes: Every April 20, 2026 subobjective is mapped to an end-to-end analyst decision spanning source, transformation, model, DAX, report, distribution, refresh, and security. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover the complete published scope. All 27 URLs are cataloged: 24 reachable and three commercial pages access-blocked. The September 7 watch treats the AI at Work roadmap as mutable discovery evidence, not a Power BI blueprint, while retaining diverse independent modeling and DAX explanations.

findings.title: Calculated columns are not uniformly materialized
findings.evidence: Expression Context and storage mode change evaluation; Direct Lake on OneLake columns are unmaterialized preview and cannot be relationship keys.
findings.recommendation: Qualify the calculation table and DP-600 answer; add mode/context checks.
findings.resolution: Qualify the calculation table and DP-600 answer; add mode/context checks.

findings.title: A duplicate survivor needs a deterministic contract
findings.evidence: Folding and optimization can change which row Table.Distinct retains; buffering has memory/folding trade-offs.
findings.recommendation: Explain keys, order, tie-breakers and source-side versus buffered patterns.
findings.resolution: Explain keys, order, tie-breakers and source-side versus buffered patterns.

findings.title: Filter replacement differs from intersection
findings.evidence: CALCULATE overwrites ordinary same-column filters unless KEEPFILTERS preserves their intersection.
findings.recommendation: Add original Hardware/Software worked example and lab predictions.
findings.resolution: Add original Hardware/Software worked example and lab predictions.

findings.title: Distinct totals are not row sums
findings.evidence: Overlapping customers appear once in the total context; BLANK is a counted distinct value.
findings.recommendation: Add set-based reconciliation example instead of automatic total replacement.
findings.resolution: Add set-based reconciliation example instead of automatic total replacement.

findings.title: Visual-local results have delivery and semantic limits
findings.evidence: Previous axis value need not be previous calendar year; current docs exclude visual result exports and value-change alert triggering.
findings.recommendation: Add missing-year example and route checks.
findings.resolution: Add missing-year example and route checks.

findings.title: Roles add permissions and author roles change enforcement
findings.evidence: Multiple roles are additive; Viewer+Build retains RLS while Contributor bypasses consumer RLS. Test-as-role has identity/SSO/Copilot limits.
findings.recommendation: Add role-union example and actual-consumer tests.
findings.resolution: Add role-union example and actual-consumer tests.

findings.title: CSV is outside supported label-protected export routes
findings.evidence: Current docs exclude CSV and unsupported paths from label/protection propagation.
findings.recommendation: Specify supported file routes and exported-file/recipient testing.
findings.resolution: Specify supported file routes and exported-file/recipient testing.

findings.title: A failed refresh schedule can disable itself
findings.evidence: Four failures or an unrecoverable configuration error can deactivate schedules; inactivity also pauses them.
findings.recommendation: Add repair/re-enable and distinct refresh-type evidence.
findings.resolution: Add repair/re-enable and distinct refresh-type evidence.

findings.title: Display-only bookmarks are not security boundaries
findings.evidence: Copilot can summarize eligible hidden bookmarked visuals while retaining RLS/OLS.
findings.recommendation: Add bookmark prerequisites, citation/filter checks and hidden-field correction.
findings.resolution: Add bookmark prerequisites, citation/filter checks and hidden-field correction.

findings.title: Q&A retirement has been extended
findings.evidence: September Microsoft announcement explicitly moves December 2026 retirement to February 2027, consistent with updated limitations docs.
findings.recommendation: Record extension and old-page discrepancy; add February research checkpoint.
findings.resolution: Record extension and old-page discrepancy; add February research checkpoint.

findings.title: Older Desktop file picker has an October transition
findings.evidence: August release notes announce loss of OneDrive/SharePoint save/share for March 2026 and earlier Desktop from October.
findings.recommendation: Add update/test guidance and dated research checkpoint without claiming local PBIX retirement.
findings.resolution: Add update/test guidance and dated research checkpoint without claiming local PBIX retirement.

objective_baseline_acceptance.previous_text:
Skills measured as of April 20, 2026
Audience profile
As a candidate for this exam, you should deliver actionable insights by working
with available data and applying domain expertise. You should provide meaningful
business value through easy-to-comprehend data visualizations and enable others
to perform self-service analytics.
As a Power BI data analyst, you work closely with business stakeholders to
identify business requirements. You collaborate with analytics engineers and
data engineers to identify and acquire data. You use Power BI to prepare the
data, model the data, visualize and analyze data, and manage and secure Power BI.
You should be proficient at using Power Query and Data Analysis Expressions
(DAX).

Skills at a glance
Prepare the data (25–30%)
Model the data (25–30%)
Visualize and analyze the data (25–30%)
Manage and secure Power BI (15–20%)

Prepare the data (25–30%)
Get or connect to data
Identify and connect to data sources or a shared semantic model
Change data source settings, including credentials and privacy levels
Choose between DirectLake, DirectQuery, and Import
Create and modify parameters

Profile and clean the data
Evaluate data, including data statistics and column properties
Resolve inconsistencies, unexpected or null values, and data quality issues
Resolve data import errors

Transform and load the data
Select appropriate column data types
Create and transform columns
Group and aggregate rows
Pivot, unpivot, and transpose data
Convert semi-structured data to a table
Create fact tables and dimension tables
Identify when to use reference or duplicate queries and the resulting impact
Merge and append queries
Identify and create appropriate keys for relationships
Configure data loading for queries

Model the data (25–30%)
Design and implement a data model
Configure table and column properties
Implement role-playing dimensions
Define a relationship's cardinality and cross-filter direction
Create a common date table
Identify use cases for calculated columns and calculated tables

Create model calculations by using DAX
Create single aggregation measures
Use the CALCULATE function
Implement time intelligence measures
Use basic statistical functions
Create semi-additive measures
Create a measure by using quick measures
Create calculated tables or columns
Create calculation groups

Optimize model performance
Improve performance by identifying and removing unnecessary rows and columns
Identify poorly performing measures, relationships, and visuals by using
Performance Analyzer and DAX query view
Improve performance by reducing granularity

Visualize and analyze the data (25–30%)
Create reports
Select an appropriate visual
Format and configure visuals
Create a narrative visual with Copilot
Apply and customize a theme
Apply conditional formatting
Apply slicing and filtering
Use Copilot to create a new report page
Use Copilot to suggest content for a new report page
Configure the report page
Choose when to use a paginated report
Create visual calculations by using DAX

Enhance reports for usability and storytelling
Configure bookmarks
Create custom tooltips
Edit and configure interactions between visuals
Configure navigation for a report
Apply sorting to visuals
Configure sync slicers
Group and layer visuals by using the Selection pane
Configure drillthrough navigation, including pages, filters, and buttons
Configure export settings
Design reports for mobile devices
Enable personalization in a report, including personalized visuals
Design and configure Power BI reports for accessibility
Configure automatic page refresh

Identify patterns and trends
Use the Analyze feature in Power BI
Use grouping, binning, and clustering
Use AI visuals
Use reference lines, error bars, and forecasting
Detect outliers and anomalies
Use Copilot to summarize the underlying semantic model

Manage and secure Power BI (15–20%)
Create and manage workspaces and assets
Create and configure a workspace
Configure and update an app
Publish, import, or update items in a workspace
Create dashboards
Choose a distribution method
Configure subscriptions and data alerts
Promote or certify Power BI content
Identify when a gateway is required
Configure a semantic model scheduled refresh

Secure and govern Power BI items
Assign workspace roles
Configure item-level access
Configure access to semantic models
Implement row-level security roles
Configure row-level security group membership
Apply sensitivity labels
